_note: Retention messages (App Store Connect, shown when a subscriber starts to cancel). Header <= 66 chars, body <= 144 chars (ASC API limits). No prices, discounts, offers or trial wording: App Review rejects them. Plan: .claude/3.1.9-retention-messages.md

en-GB: Your journal stays yours, whatever you choose
Without Core, you keep writing, search, iCloud backup and every reflection already made. New daily reflections, Ask and weekly digests stop.
